about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The Hmong Clothing Shop was founded out of love for Hmong culture, to preserve its unique embroidery patterns for generations to come
about.storyText: We started as a small shop in Vientiane, tailoring and embroidering Hmong outfits for our community. Today we have grown into an online store, bringing the beauty of Hmong embroidery to everyone nationwide. Every piece is carefully selected and quality-checked before it reaches your hands.
about.v1x: Every piece hand-embroidered by artisans with over 10 years of experience
about.v2x: We carry on the patterns and wisdom of our ancestors
about.v3x: We support local embroiderers with fair, steady work
about.v4x: Carefully chosen fabrics and materials, made to last

craft.title: The Craft Behind Every Stitch
craft.subtitle: Follow the journey of a Hmong outfit: from plain cloth to a hand-embroidered masterpiece
craft.processSub: Every outfit passes through five careful stages, each one done by hand
craft.p1x: We choose thick, quality cotton and hemp that holds embroidery well and lasts for years
craft.p2x: Artisans draw classic Hmong motifs by hand: spirals, snails and stars passed down for generations
craft.p3x: The paj ntaub is stitched thread by thread; a single panel can take weeks of patient work
craft.p4x: Skirt pleats, sashes and trims are cut and sewn together into a complete outfit
craft.p5x: Each finished piece is inspected stitch by stitch before it is packed and sent to your door
craft.showSub: A few pieces that recently left the artisans' hands, each one stitched the way you just saw
craft.quote: Each pattern tells a story. When you wear it, you carry our history with you.
craft.ctaTitle: Own a Piece of the Craft
craft.ctaText: Browse our hand-embroidered collection, or ask our tailors for a custom-made outfit

1.name: Traditional Hmong Women's Outfit
1.desc: A traditional Hmong women's outfit, hand-embroidered at every step, with a pleated skirt and classic-pattern apron. Perfect for festivals and special occasions.

2.name: Hand-Embroidered Hmong Shirt
2.desc: A 100% hand-embroidered Hmong shirt with fine, detailed patterns. Quality cotton, comfortable to wear, and easy to pair with modern outfits.

3.name: Classic-Pattern Hmong Skirt
3.desc: A pleated Hmong skirt with classic patterns and bright colors. Beautiful flowing fabric that fans out gracefully — perfect for dancing and photos.

4.name: Complete Hmong Men's Outfit
4.desc: A complete Hmong men's outfit: shirt, trousers, and sash. Thick black fabric with beautifully embroidered trim for a dignified look.

5.name: Hmong Children's Hat
5.desc: An adorable Hmong children's hat with delicate embroidery and colorful tassels. Available in several sizes.

6.name: Hmong Silver Belt
6.desc: An authentic Hmong silver belt, hand-forged by experienced silversmiths with intricate patterns. An heirloom to pass down for generations.

7.name: Embroidered Hmong Scarf
7.desc: A soft Hmong embroidered scarf for every season. A gift rich in cultural meaning.

8.name: Hmong Girl's Outfit
8.desc: A complete Hmong outfit for girls with hat and accessories. Bright, adorable colors — perfect for Hmong New Year celebrations.
